verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for an invoicing SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents one with runnable examples or a try-it console. The probes found only a 404 for the API docs markdown path and 404s for every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path; the marketing pages say nothing about an API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
